Hello My Hungry Friends!!

🇵🇱 Looking for Sponsors & Brand Partners! 🇺🇸

Do you own or represent a Polish food business, pottery company, gift shop, or Polish-themed brand in the U.S.? We’d love to partner with you!

Polish Your Kitchen is looking for businesses interested in sponsoring a YouTube video and getting their products in front of an engaged audience interested in Polish food, cooking, culture, and traditions.

Why partner with Polish Your Kitchen?

Authentic product exposure — Your products can be naturally incorporated into a cooking video and presented to viewers in an engaging, personal way.

Dedicated YouTube visibility — Your brand can be featured and mentioned during a video, giving potential customers an opportunity to discover your business.

Reach the Polish-American community — Connect with people who love Polish traditions, foods, and products and are looking for ways to bring Poland into their everyday lives.

Drive awareness & potential sales — Showcase what makes your products special and give viewers a reason to visit your shop or website.

Build a connection with a trusted creator — Sponsorship is more than an advertisement; it’s an opportunity to introduce your brand through authentic storytelling and content that people enjoy.

Whether you sell Polish foods, pottery, gifts, souvenirs, or other products connected to Polish culture, let’s talk!

📩 Interested in sponsoring a video or perhaps a multi-platform campaign? I will adjust to your brand’s needs.

Mark and I are looking forward to working with you!

Contact: mailto:polishyourkitchen@gmail.com

    Meet Anna

    Welcome to my Polish food blog! Here, I share memories of growing up in Poland in the 80s and 90s, and Polish food and customs patiently kept alive at my Polish-American home. I’m not a professional chef, just a home cook influenced by years of listening, watching and tasting, who's constantly craving flavors and smells of home. Join my network of friends and stay in touch with your roots through my stories.
